sampling: Retain all 2553 existing records; take first 500 non-existing IDs per source ranked by SHA256([seed,source,id]) after screening. HelpSteer2 extends original SHA-ranked quality-only pair sample to 1000. No replacement.
screen: Exact normalized >=8 words; >=80% containment of 16-word shingles with >=5 shared shingles. Heuristic, not proof against paraphrases or shared ancestry.
cache: New rows require extraction; existing matching request hashes remain reusable.
